English: Preterm birth is delivery before 37 completed weeks.
Luganda: Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kubaawo nga wiiki 37 tezinnawera.
Yoruba: Ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́ ni èyí tó bá ṣẹlẹ̀ sáájú ọ̀ṣẹ̀ 37.
Zulu: Ukuteta ngaohambi kwesikhathi ukubeletha ngaphambi kokuqedaamaviki awu-37.
Hausa: Haihuwar bakwaini shi ne haihuwa kafin cikar makonni 37.
Northern Sotho: Pelego ya pele ga nako ke go belega pele ga ge moimana a ka fetša dibeke tše 37 tša boimana.
Amharic: ቅድመ ወሊድ 37ቱን የእርግዝና ሳምንታት ሳያጠናቅቁ መውለድ ማለት ነው፡፡

English: A study was conducted to evaluate the association of maternal serum concentrations of selenium, copper, and zinc, and preterm birth.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa okwekenneenya akakwate wakati wa seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki, n’okuzaala abaana abatannatuuka.
Yoruba: A ṣe ìwádìí láti ṣe ìgbédìde fún àṣepọ̀ ipò abo lórí i sẹ́lẹ́líómù, kọ́pà, síǹkì, àti ìkúnlẹ̀ à̀ìtọ́jọ́.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwenziwa ukuhlolisisa ukuhlobana kokushuba kwesileniyami, umthofi kanye nezinki kwi-serum yomama, kanye nokuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
Hausa: An gudanar da wani bincike don kimanta alaƙar yawan jinin haihuwa da sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da sinadarin zin da kuma haihuwar bakwaini.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di dirilwe go sekaseka go amana ga seramo ya mosadi yo a imilego le seleniamo, koporo, le zinki, le pelego ya pele ga nako.
Amharic: ከእናቶች በተወሰደው እዥ ውስጥ ያለው የሴሊኒየም፤ የመዳብ እና የዚንክ ክምችት ከቅድመ ወሊድ ጋር ያለውን ተዛማጅነት ለመገምገም ጥናት ተደርጓል፡፡

English: There were 181 women in this nested case-control study, 90/181 (49.7%) term and 91/181 (50.3%) preterm pregnant women.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwalimu abakazi 181, nga 90/181 (49.7%) baazaala abaana abatuuse ate nga 91/181 (50.3%) baazaala abaana abatannatuuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn obìnrin 181 ni ó wà nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ná̀, 90/181 (49.7%) tó jẹ́ àti 91/181 (50.3%) tí ò jẹ́ aláboyún.
Zulu: Bekanabesifazane abawu-181 kulolu cwaningo lapho umuntu aziwa ngegama. u-90/181 (u-49.7%) zafika esikhathini kanti u-91/181 (u-50.3%) bateta singakafiki isikhathi.
Hausa: Akwai mata 181 a cikin wannan binciken na musamman, 90/181 (49.7%) da 91/181 (50.3%) mata masu juna biyu kafin haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Go bile le basadi ba 181 ka mo dinyakišišišong tšeo di laotšwego ka dihlophana, 90/181 (49.7%) bao ba belego ka nako le ba 91/181 (50.3%) bao ba belegego pele ga nako.
Amharic: በዚህ ምጡን ጉዳይ አካታች ጥናት ውስጥ 181 ነፍሰጡር  ሴቶች የተካፈሉ ሲሆን፤ ከ መቶ ሰማንያ አንዱ ውስጥ 90ዎቹ ወይም (49.7%)  በጊዜያቸው የወለዱ ሲሆን፣  91 የሚሆኑት ወይም (50.3 %) ደግሞ ቅድመ ወሊድ ያጋጠማቸው ናቸው፡፡

English: The overall mean serum concentration of selenium was 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, copper was 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L and zinc was 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L with reference values of 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L and 0.59-1.11 mg/L, respectively.
Luganda: Omuwendo gwa sleniyamu ogwali mu musaayi gwali 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, ekikomo gwali 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L ne zinki gwali 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L ng’emiwendo egigeraageranyizibwako giri 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L ne 0.59-1.11 mg/L, mu kuddiriŋŋana okwo.
Yoruba: Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé àpapọ̀ sẹ̀lẹ́níómù jẹ́ 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, kọ́pà jẹ́ 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L and síǹkì jẹ́ 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L pẹ̀lú ìtọ́ka iye 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L and 0.59-1.11 mg/L, ní ṣíṣe-n-tẹ̀lé.
Zulu: Isibalomaphakathi sokushuba kwe-serum sesileniyamu bekuwu-77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, umthofi bekuwu-2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L kanti izinki bekuwu-0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L namananisiqhathaniso ka-47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L kanye no-0.59-1.11 mg/L, ngokulandelana.
Hausa: Matsakaicin matsakaitan yawan ƙwayar sinadarin saleniyam shi ne 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, jan ƙarfe ya kasance 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L da kuma sinadarin zin ya kasance 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L tare da waiwaye ga darajoji na 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L da kuma 0.59-1.11 mg/L, bi da bi.
Northern Sotho: Kakaretšo ya fasefase ya motswako wa seramo ya seleniamo e bile 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, wa koporo e bile 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L gomme wa zinki wa ba 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L go lebeletše boleng bjo bo šupšwago bja 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L le 0.59-1.11 mg/L, ka go latelana.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ ለመናገር፣  ከእነዚህ መነሻ እሴቶች ማለትም፤ ከ 47-142ug/L, 0.76-1.59ሚግ/L እና 0.59-1.11ሚግ/L አንጻር በእዥ ውስጥ ያለው የሴሊኒየም ክምችት  77.0; SD 19.4ug/L, መዳብ ደግሞ፣ 2.50; SD 0.52ሚግ/L፤ እንዲሁም የዚንክ መጠን 0.77;SD 0.20ሚግ/L በቅደም ተከተል ነበር፡፡

English: For preterm birth, mean serum concentrations for selenium was 79.7; SD 21.6µg/L, copper was 2.61; SD 0.57 mg/L, and zinc was 0.81; SD 0.20 mg/L compared to that of term births: selenium (74.2; SD 16.5µg/L; p=0.058), copper (2.39; SD 0.43 mg/L; p = 0.004), and zinc (0.73; SD 0.19 mg/L; p = 0.006) respectively.
Luganda: Mu baazaala abaana abatannatuuka, omuwendo gwa eleniyamu gwali 79.7; SD 21.6µg/L, ekikomo 2.61; SD 0.57 mg/L, ne zinki 0.81; SD 0.20 mg/L bw’ogeraageranya n’egy’abaazaala abaana abatuuse: seleniyamu (74.2; SD 16.5µg/L; p=0.058), ekikomo (2.39; SD 0.43 mg/L; p = 0.004), ne zinki (0.73; SD 0.19 mg/L; p = 0.006) mu kuddiriŋŋana okwo.
Yoruba: For preterm birth, mean serum concentrations for selenium was 79.7; SD 21.6µg/L, copper was 2.61; SD 0.57 mg/L, and zinc was 0.81; SD 0.20 mg/L compared to that of term births: selenium (74.2; SD 16.5µg/L; p=0.058), copper (2.39; SD 0.43 mg/L; p = 0.004), and zinc (0.73; SD 0.19 mg/L; p = 0.006) respectively.
Zulu: Kulaba abatete ngaphambi kwesikhathi, isibalomaphakathi sokushuba kwesileniyamu sasiwu-79.7; SD 21.6µg/L, umthofi kwakuwu-2.61; 0.57mg/L, kanti izinki kwakuwu- 0.81; SD 0.20 mg/L kuqhathaniswa nabatete ngesikhathi: isileniyamu (74.2; SD 16.5µg/L; p=0.058), umthofi (2.39; SD 0.43 mg/L; p = 0.004), kanye nezinki (0.73; SD 0.19 mg/L; p= 0.006) ngokulandelana.
Hausa: Don haifuwar bakwaini, matsakaitan yawan ƙwayar sinadarin saleniyam shi ne 79.7; SD 21.6µg/L, jan ƙarfe ya kasance 2.61; SD 0.57 mg/L, kuma sinadarin zin ya kasance 0.81; SD 0.20 mg/L idan aka kwatanta da na lokacin haihuwa: Sinadarin saleniyam (74.2; SD 16.5µg/L; p=0.058), jan ƙarfe (2.39; SD 0.43 mg/L; p = 0.004), da kuma sinadarin zin (0.73; SD 0.19 mg/L; p = 0.006) bi da bi.
Northern Sotho: Go pelego ya pele ga nako, metswako ya fasefase ya seramo ya seleniamo e bile 79.7; SD 21.6µg/L, ya koporo e bile 2.61; SD 0.57 mg/L, gomme ya zinki e bile 0.81; SD 0.20 mg/L ge go bapetšwa le pele pelego ya ka nako: seleniamo e bile (74.2; SD 16.5µg/L; p=0.058), koporo e bile (2.39; SD 0.43 mg/L; p = 0.004), gomme ya zinki e bile (0.73; SD 0.19 mg/L; p = 0.006) ka go latelana.
Amharic: ወቅቱን ከጠበቀ ውልደት ጋር ስናነጻጽረው፤ ቅድመ ወሊድ ማለት በእዥ ውስጥ ያለው የሴሊኒየም ክምችት 79.7፤ SD 21.6ug/L ፣ የመዳብ ክምችት 2.61፤ SD 0.57ሚግ/L, እንዲሁም የዚንክ ደግሞ 0.81፤ SD 0.20ሚግ/L ነበር ማለት ነው፡፡ሴሊኒየም (74.2;SD 16.5ug/L;p=0.058), እና ዚንክ(0.73;SD 0.19ሚግ/L;P=0.006) በቅደም ተከተል፡፡

English: In adjusted analysis, every unit increase in maternal selenium concentrations gave increased odds of being a case OR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03), p=0.234, copper OR 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184, zinc OR 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67); p=0.032.
Luganda: Mu kwekenneenya okukyusakyusiddwa, buli katundu ka seleniyamu akeeyongeramu kaaleetawo okweyongera kw’emikisa gy’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka OR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03), p=0.234, ekikomo OR 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184, zinki OR 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67); p=0.032.
Yoruba: In adjusted analysis, every unit increase in maternal selenium concentrations gave increased odds of being a case OR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03), p=0.234, copper OR 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184, zinc OR 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67); p=0.032.
Zulu: Ekuhlaziyweni okulungisiwe, konke ukwenyuka kwamayunithi ekushubeni kwesileniyamu kwaphula amathuba okuba i-case OR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03), p=0.234, umthofi OR 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184, izinki OR 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67); p=0.032.
Hausa: A cikin binciken da aka daidaita, kowane nau'i na ƙaruwa a cikin ƙananan ƙwayar sinadarin saleniyam na mahaifa ya ba da damar haɓakar kasancewa ko 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03), p = 0.234, jan ƙarfe KO 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184, sinadarin zin KO 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67); p=0.032.
Northern Sotho: Ka tshekatshekong yeo e beakantšwego leswa, koketšego ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya ka metswako ya seleniamo ya boimana e bile le koketšego ya mathata OR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03), p=0.234, koporo OR 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184, zinki OR 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67); p=0.032.
Amharic: በተስተካከለው ትንተና፤  በእናት ውስጥ  የሚከሰተው እያንዳንዱ የሴሊኒየም ክምችት ክፍል  መጨመር፤ የቅድመ ወሊድ ተጠቂ የመሆን እድልን ያሰፋዋል፡፡  OR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99; 1.03)፣ p=0.234, መዳብ OR 1.62 (95% CI: 0.80; 3.32); p = 0.184፣ ዚንክ OR 6.88 (95% CI: 1.25; 43.67)፣ p=0.032 ፡፡

English: Researchers found high concentrations of the micronutrients selenium, copper, and zinc, in women who had preterm births, but they still do not know whether these high concentrations come from the food they eat.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula omuwendo gw’ebiriisa bya seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mungi mu bakazi abaazaala abaana abatannatuuka, naye era tebannamanya oba ng’ebiriisa bino ebingi biva mu mmere gye balya.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí rí àpọ̀ju àwọn èròjà aṣaralóore kékèké bí i sẹ̀rílíọ́mù, cọ́pà, àti síǹkì, nínú àwọn obìnrin tí ó ní ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò mọ̀ bóyá àwọn àpọ̀jù wọnyí wá́ látara oúnjẹ tí wọ́n ń jẹ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukushuba kwemisoco edingeka kancane isiliniyamu, umthofi kanye nezinki kubantu besifazane abateta ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa abakazi noma loku kushuba okuphezulu kuqhamuka ekudleni abakudlayo yini.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun gano yawan ma'adanai na sinadiran saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadari zin, a cikin matan da suka haifi bakwaini, amma har yanzu ba su san ko waɗannan abubuwan da ke tattare da su sun fito ne daga abincin da suke ci ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše metswako nya godimo ya dijonyana tša seleniamo, koporo le tša zinki, go basadi bao ba bilego le pelego ya pele ga nako, eupša mo lebakeng le ga ba tsebe ge eba metswako ye ya godimo e tšwa go dijo tše ba di jago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የሴሊኒየም፤ መዳብ እና ዚንክ ደቂቅ ንጥረ ምግብ  ክፍተኛ ክምችትን ቅድመ ወሊድ ባጋጠማቸው ሴቶች ላይ አግኝተዋል፡፡ ሆኖም ግን እነዚህ ከፍተኛ ክምችቶች የመጡት ከሚመገቧቸው ምግቦች ይሁን አይሁን እስካሁን አላወቁም፡፡

English: A preterm birth occurs when a woman gives birth before she completes 37 weeks of pregnancy.
Luganda: Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kibaawo ng’omukazi azadde ng’olubuto terunnaweza wiiki 37.
Yoruba: Ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́ máa ń ṣẹ̀ tí obiùnrin bá bímọ ṣáájú ọ̀ṣẹ̀ 37 tí ó lóyún.
Zulu: Ukuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwenzeka uma owesifazane eteta ngaphambi kwamasonto awu-37 okukhulelwa.
Hausa: Haihuwar bakwaini na faruwa ne lokacin da mace ta haihu kafin ta cika makonni 37 na ciki.
Northern Sotho: Pelego ya pele ga nako e hlaga ge mosadi a belega lesea pele a fetša dibeke tše 37 tša boimana.
Amharic: ቅድመ  ወሊድ የሚከሰተው አንዲት ሴት 37ቱን የእርግዝና ሳምንታት ሳትጨርስ በምትወልድበት ወቅት ነው፡፡

English: Preterm birth is associated with negative health outcomes for the baby ranging from birth defects to death.
Luganda: Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kiviiramu omwana okuba n’embeera z’obulamu embi omuli okuzaalibwa n’obulemu awamu n’okufa.
Yoruba: Ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́ jẹ́ èyí tó ní ìbáṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn àìlera fún ọmọ láti kí ara ọmọ́ má dà á sí ikú.
Zulu: Ukuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela yezempilo engemihle engani kusukela ezicini ekuzalwani kuye ekufeni.
Hausa: Haihuwar bakwaini tana da alaƙa da mummunan sakamakon lafiya ga jariri tun daga lahani na haihuwa zuwa mutuwa.
Northern Sotho: Pelego ya pele ga nako e amantšhwa le dipoelo tša maphelo tše di sego tša loka go lesea go thoma ka mathata a pelego go fihla go lehu.
Amharic: ቅድመ  ወሊድ ህጻኑን ከሚያጋጠሙት ከልደት ጉደለቶች ጀምሮ፤ እስከ ሞት የሚያደርሱ  አሉታዊ የጤና እክሎች ጋር ተዛማጅነት አለው፡፡

English: There can be many causes to preterm birth, but the role of high concentrations of micronutrients found in food and the environment is relatively unknown.
Luganda: Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kiyinza okuleetebwa ebintu eby’enjawulo, naye eky’ebiriisa ebingi ebisangibwa mu mmere n’ebyetoolodde omuntu tekimanyiddwa bulungi.
Yoruba: Ohun tí ó lè fa ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́ pọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ipa tí àpọ̀jù àwọn èròjà aṣaralóore kékèké tí à ń rí nínú oúnjẹ àti agbègbè wá jẹ́ èyí tí a ò tí ì mọ̀.
Zulu: Zingaba ziningi izimbangela zokuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi kodwa indima yokushuba okuohezulu kwemisoco edingakala kancane etholakala ekudleni nasemvelweni ayaziwa kahle.
Hausa: Akwai dalilai da yawa na haifar da haihuwar bakwaini, amma ba a san rawar da yawan ma'adanai na abubuwan gina jiki da ake samu a abinci da muhalli suke takawa ba.
Northern Sotho: Go ka ba le dilo tše ntši tše di bakago pelego ya pele ga nako, eupša tema ye e kgathwago ke motswako wa godimo wa dijonyana tšeo di hwetšwago ka dijong le tikologo ga e tsebje.
Amharic: ለቅድመ  ወሊድ መከሰት ብዙ ምክንያቶች  ሊኖሩ ቢችሉም፤በምግብ እና በአካባቢው ውስጥ  የሚገኘው ከፍተኛ የደቂቅ ንጥረ ምግቦች ክምችት ያለው ሚና በአንጻራዊ መልኩ አይታወቅም፡፡

English: These micronutrients are important for the development of the baby, but researchers want to know what happens when there is too much of them.
Luganda: Ebiriisa bino bya mugaso mu kukula kw’omwana, naye abanoonyereza baagala okumanya kiki ekibaawo singa biba bingi nnyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn àpapọ̀ àwọn èròjà aṣaralóore kékèké yìí ṣe pàtàkì sí ìdàgbàsókẹ̀ ọmọ náà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn olùṣèwádìí fẹ́ mọ̀ ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ tí wọ́n bá pò jù.
Zulu: Le misoco edingeka kancane ibalulekile ekukhuleni kwengane, kodwa abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzakalani uma isikhona ngokweqile.
Hausa: Waɗannan abubuwan gina jiki suna da mahimmanci ga ci gaban jariri, amma masu bincike suna so su san abin da zai faru idan akwai su da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Dijonyana tše di bohlokwa go goleng ga lesea, eupša banyakišiši ba nyaka go tseba gore go direga eng ge go na le bontši bja tšona kudu.
Amharic: እነዚህ ደቂቅ ንጥረ ምግቦች ለህጻኑ እድገት አስፈላጊ ቢሆኑም፤በብዛት በሚገኙበት ወቅት ምን ሊያጋጥም እንደሚችል ተመራማሪዎቹ መረዳት ይፈልጋሉ፡፡

English: For this study, researchers aimed to measure the amounts of selenium, copper, and zinc in women who had preterm births, and then to determine the odds that preterm birth is caused by high amounts of each of the micronutrients studied.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baagenderera okupima obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mu bakazi abaazaala abaana abatannatuuka, bazuule oba ng’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kyaleetebwa buli kimu ku biriisa bino okuba nga kyali kingi nnyo.
Yoruba: Fún ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùṣèwádìí gbèrò láti mo iye ìwọn sẹ̀rílíọ́mù, cọ́pà, àti síǹkì nínú obìnrin tí ó ní ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́, àti láti bí ipa tí ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀nkan àwọn èròja yí ń kó nínú ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphokophele ukukala amanani esileniyami, umthofi kanye nezinki kwabesifazne abatete ngapgambi kwesikhathi, bese behlonza amathuba okuthi ukuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubangwe amanani aphezulu ale misoco ngamunye ecwaningiwe.
Hausa: Don wannan binciken, masu bincike sun yi niyyar auna adadin sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da sinadarin zin a cikin matan da suka haifi bakwaini, sannan kuma don tantance rashin yiwuwar haihuwar bakwaini yana faruwa ne sakamakon yawan adadin kowane nau'in abubuwan gina jiki da aka nazarta.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba ikemišeditše go ela ditekano tša seleniamo, tša koporo, le tša zinki go basadi bao ba bilego le pelego ya pele ga nako, le gape go tseba taba ya gore pelego ya pele ga nako e baka ditekano tša godimo tša dijonyana tše dingwe le tše dingwe tšeo di nyakišišitšwego.
Amharic: ለዚህም ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ  ቅድመ  ወሊድ ባጋጠማቸው ሴቶች ውስጥ ያሉትን   የሴሊኒየም፤ መዳብ እና ዚንክ መጠኖችን በመለካት  ፤ በእነዚህ ጥናት ሲደረገባቸው በነበሩት ደቂቅ ንጥረ ምግቦች ምክንያት ቅድመ ወሊድ የመከሰት እድሉ ምን ያህል እንደሆነ ለመለካት አቅደዋል፡፡

English: The researchers collected blood samples from 181 women right after they gave birth at two hospitals in Lilongwe, the capital of Malawi, between June 2016 and March 2017.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya sampolo z’omusaayi okuva ku bakazi 181 nga baakazaala mu malwaliro abiri mu Lilongwe, ekibuga ekikulu ekya Malawi, wakati w’Ogwomukaaga 2016 n’Ogwokusatu 2017.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣẹ̀wádií náà gba èjẹ̀ àwọn obìrin 181 lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n bímọ tán ní họsibítù méjì ní Lilongwe, ní olú ìlúu Malawi, láàárín June 2016 àti March 2017.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula egazi kwabesifazane abawu-181 ngemuva nje kokuthi betete ezibhedlela ezimbili eLilongwe, inhlokodolobha yaseMalawi, ohakathi kuka-June 2016 no-March 2017.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattara samfurin jini daga mata 181 kai-tsaye bayan sun haihu a asibitoci biyu a Lilongwe, babban birnin Malawi, tsakanin watan Yuni na shekarar 2016 da kuma Maris 2017.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba kgobokeditše disampole tša madi go basadi ba 181 thwii ka pela ka morago ga ge ba belege ka dipetleleng tše pedi ka Lilongwe, motsemošate wa Malawi, magareng ga June 2016 le Matšhe 2017.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እ.ኢ.አ በሰኔ 2016 ዓ.ም. እና የካቲት 2017 ዓ.ም.  መካከል የማላዊ ዋና ከተማ በሆነችው በሊሎንጉዌ  ከሚገኙ ሁለት ሆስፒታሎች 181 ሴቶች ወዲያውኑ እንደወለዱ የደም ናሙናቸውን  ወስደው ነበር፡፡

English: They shipped the blood samples to a laboratory in Norway where they extracted the serum, a purer form of blood, and measured the amounts of selenium, copper and zinc.
Luganda: Baaweereza sampolo z’omusaayi mu ggezeserezo mu Norway gye gwakenenulwamu seramu, nga guno gwe musaayi gwennyini, ne bapima obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbé àwọn àpẹẹrẹ èjẹ̀ náà lọ sí inú láàbù ní orílẹ̀-ède Norway níbi tí wọ́n ti ṣe àfàyọ sẹ́rúmù tí wọ́n sì ṣe ìwọn sẹ̀rílíọ́mù, kọ́pà àti síǹkì.
Zulu: Bathutha amasapmula egazi aya elabhorethri e-Norway lapho abakhipha khona i-serum, isimo esicwebile kangcono segazi, base bekala amanani esileniyamu, umthofi kanye nezinki.
Hausa: Sun aika da samfuran jinin ne zuwa ɗakin gwaje-gwaje a ƙasar Norway inda suka fitar da ƙwayar jini, nau'in jini mafi kyau, kuma sun auna adadin sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadarin zin.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba romela disampole ytša madi ka sekepe laporatyhoring ya ka Norway fao ba ilego ba ntšha seramo, sebopego seo se hlwekilego sa madi, gomme ba ela ditekano tša seleniamo, tša koporo le tša zinki.
Amharic: የደም ናሙናዎቹንም ኖርዌይ ወደሚገኝ ላብራቶሪ ልከዋቸው ነበር፡፡ እዚያም  በውስጣቸው ያለው እዥ (ወይም ምንም ያልተቀላቀለበት ንጹሁ ደም) ተለይቶ ከወጣ በኋላ፣  በውስጡ ያሉትን የሴሊኒየም፤ የመዳብ እና የዚንክ  መጠን ለክተዋል፡፡

English: About half of the 181 women in the study had preterm births, and researchers found very high amounts of selenium, copper and zinc.
Luganda: Ekitundu nga kimu kyakubiri ku bakazi 181 abaali mu kunoonyereza baali bazadde abaana abatannatuuka, era abanoonyereza baasanga omuwendo gwa seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki mungi nnyo.
Yoruba: Bí i ìdajì lára àwọn 181 obìrin náà tí wọ́n lò nínú ìwádìí náà ló ní ìkúlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ àwọn olùṣèwádìí rí àpọ̀ju sẹ̀rílíọ̀mù, kọ́pà àti síǹkì.
Zulu: Cishe uhhafu walaba besifazane ocwaningweni bateta ngaphambi kwesikhathi kanti abacwaningi bathola amazinga aphezulu kakhulu esileniyamu, umthofi kanye nezinki.
Hausa: Kimanin rabin mata 181 da aka gudanar da binciken a kan su sun haifi bakwaini, kuma masu bincike sun gano sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadarin zin da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Palo ye e ka bago seripagare sa basadi ba 181 ka dinyakišišong ba bile le dipelego tša pele ga nako, gomme banyakišiši ba hweditše ditekanyo tša godimo kudu tša seleniamo, tša koporo le tša zinki.
Amharic: በጥናቱ ውስጥ ከተካተቱት 181 ሴቶች፣ ግማሽ የሚሆኑት ቅድመ ወሊድ  ያጋጠማቸው  ሲሆን፤ በእነዚህም ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎቹ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያላቸው የሴሊኒየም፤ የመዳብ እና የዚንክ መጠኖችን አግኝተዋል፡፡

English: They then adjusted their calculations to account for many other factors such as age, general health, and pregnancy history to tease out the suspected effects of the micronutrients in causing preterm birth.
Luganda: Awo ate baakyusaamu ku bibalo byabwe okwetegereza ensonga endala nnyingi ng’obukulu, embeera y’obulamu, n’ebyafaayo by’embuto okukakasa eky’okuba nti ebiriisa bino biviirako okuzaala abaana abatannatuuka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì ṣe àtúnṣe ìṣirò wọn láti ṣàfihàn fún àwọn ìdí mìíràn bí i ọjọ́-orí, àjíǹde ara, àti ìtàn ìlóyún láti lè rí okùnfa àwọn èròjà aṣaralóore kékèké tí ó ń fa ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́ náà.
Zulu: Babe sebefanelisa izibalo zabo ukucabangela eminye imithelela efana neminyaka, isimo nje sempilo, kanye nomlando wokukhulelwa ukuze bavumulule le mithelela esolwayo yale misoco edingeka kancane ekubangeleni ukuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka daidaita lissafinsu don yin la’akari da wasu dalilai da yawa kamar shekaru da lafiya gabaɗaya da tarihin ciki don samun madogara game da zargin illolin da abubuwan gina jiki ke haifarwa na haihuwar bakwaini.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba beakanya leswa ditlhakanyo tša bona go akaretša mabaka a mangwe a mantši a go swana le mengwaga, maphelo ka kakaretšo, le histori ya boimana go utolla mabaka ao a bego a gononelwa a gore dijonyana di baka pelego ya pele ga nako.
Amharic: በመቀጠልም ከደቂቅ ንጥረ ምግቦች በተጨማሪ ለቅድመ ወሊድ መከሰት  በምክንያትነት የተጠረጠሩትን  እንደ እድሜ፤ ጠቅላላ የጤንነት ሁኔታ፤እና የእርግዝና ታሪክ የመሳሰሉትን ሌሎች ምክንያቶች  ከግምት ውስጥ ለማስገባት ስሌቶቻቸውን  አስተካክለዋል፡፡

English: They concluded that large amounts of selenium and copper did not play a significant role in causing preterm birth, but that high amounts of zinc increased the risk of preterm birth by over 6 times.
Luganda: Baakomekkereza nti omuwendo omungi ogwa seleniyamu n’ekikomo tegwalina kya maanyi kye gwakola mu kuleetera okuzaala abaana abatannatuuka, naye nti omuwendo gwa zinki omungi gwayongera ku mikisa gy’okuzaala abaana abatannatuuka emirundi egisukka 6.
Yoruba: Wọ́n pinnu pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sẹ̀rílíọ́mù àti cọ́pà kò kó ipa tó kọjú nínú ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ síǹkì ń fi ewu kún ìwáyée ìkúnlẹ̀ àìtọ́jọ́ ju ìgbà 6.
Zulu: Baphethe ngokuthi amanani aphezulu esileniyami nomthofi awadlalanga indima ebonakalayo ekubangeleni ukuteta ngaphamabi kwesikhathi, kodwa ukuthi amanani aphezulu ezinki ayikhuphulile ingcuphe yokuteta ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngezikhathi ezingaphezu kuka-6.
Hausa: Sun yi ittifakin cewa yawan sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe ba sa taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen haifar da haihuwar bakwaini, amma yawan sinadarin zin na ƙara haɗarin haihuwar bakwaini da sama da sau 6.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba fetša ka gore ditekano tša godimo tša seleniamo le tša koporo ga se tša raloka tema ye kgolo go baka pelego ya pele ga nako, eupša ba re ditekano tša godimo tša zinki di okeditše kotsi ya pelego ya pele ga nako ka makga a go feta a 6.
Amharic: የሴሊኒየም  እና የመዳብ  በከፍተኛ መጠን መገኘት ቅድመ ወሊድን በማስከሰት ረገድ ጉልህ ሚና እንደማይጫወት ነገር ግን የዚንክ  በከፍተኛ መጠን መገኘት  ቅድመ ወሊድ የመከሰቱን አደጋ በ6 እጥፍ እንደሚጨምረው ደምድመዋል፡፡

English: The large amounts of copper however was a concern for the researchers, because of the known toxic effects.
Luganda: Wabula omuwendo gw’ekikomo omungi gwalowoozebwako nnyo abanoonyereza, olw’obuzibu bw’obutwa obumanyiddwa.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ iye cọ́pà jẹ́ ohun ìkọminú fún àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà, nítorí àwọn ohun ewu ló wà níbẹ̀.
Zulu: Amanani aphezulu omthofi abedala ukukhathazeka kubacwaningi, ngenxa yokwaziwa kwemithelela yawo enobuthi.
Hausa: Yawaitar jan ƙarfe duk da haka ya kasance damuwa ga masu bincike, saboda sakamakon da aka sani na guba.
Northern Sotho: Ditekano tša godimo tša koporo le ge go le bjale e bile tlhobaboroko go banyakišiši, ka lebaka la diabe tša mpholo tšeo di tsebegago.
Amharic: ይሁን  እንጂ  በመርዛማ ተጽእኖዎቹ የሚታወቀው መዳብ በከፍተኛ መጠን መገኘቱ ለተመራማሪዎቹ ስጋት ነበር፡፡

English: Having only 181 women participating in the study limited the researchers’ ability to properly find the risks associated with high levels of selenium, as a more suitable number of participants is 600.
Luganda: Okubeera n’abakazi 181 bokka abeetaba mu kunoonyereza kwalemesa abanoonyereza okuzuula obulungi obuzibu obukwanyizibwa n’omuwendo gwa seleniyamu omungi, olw’okuba ng’omuwendo ogwandisinze okwetaagibwa guli 600.
Yoruba: Nípa níní obìnrin 181 tí ó kọ́pa nínú ìwádìí náà ṣe ìdíwó fú àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà láti lè wá àwọn ewu tó so pọ̀ mọ́ níní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sẹ̀rílíọ́mù, léyì tó jẹ́ pé àwọn olùkópà tó yèkooro jẹ́ ẹgbẹ̀ta.
Zulu: Ukuba nabesifazane abawu-181 kuphela ababambe iqhaza ocwaningweni kukunqindile ukukwazi kwabacwaningi ukuthola kahle izingcuphe ezihlatshaniswa namanani aphezulu esileniyami, njengoba isibalo esifanele sababambiqhaza kuwu-600.
Hausa: Samun mata 181 kawai ne suka shiga cikin binciken ya iyakance ikon masu binciken don gano haɗarin da ke tattare da manyan matakan sinadarin saleniyam, kamar yadda adadin masu shiga binciken ya fi dacewa shi ne mata 600.
Northern Sotho: Go ba le fela basadi ba 181 bao ba kgathago tema ka dinyakišišong go ile gwa fokotša bokgoni bja banyakišiši bja go hwetša dikotsi ka maleba tšeo di amantšhwago le maemo a godimo a seleniamo, ka ge palo ya maleba kudu ya bakgathatema e le ba 600.
Amharic: 600 ሴቶችን ማሳተፍ የነበረበት ይህ ጥናት በ181 ሴቶች  ላይ ብቻ መሰራቱ ፤ ተመራማሪዎቹን ከሴሊኒየም ከፍተኛ  ክምችት ጋር  የተያያዙትን ችግሮች በአግባቡ ለማግኘት የመቻል አቅማቸውን ገድቦታል፡፡

English: The daily diets of the participants were not investigated to find the possible sources of three micronutrients, and their Body Mass Index (BMI) was not recorded.
Luganda: Emmere abeetabi gye balya buli lunaku teyeekenneenyezebwa okuzuula ebiriisa bino ebisatu mwe biyinza okuba nga biva, era n’obuwanvu n’obuzito tebwafunibwa.
Yoruba: A kò ṣe àyẹ̀wò fún oúnjẹ tí àwọn olùkópa náà ń jẹ láti mọ ibi tí àwọn èròjà kékèké náà ti wá, àti pé BMI wọn kò sí ní àkọsílẹ̀.
Zulu: Ukudla kwanzukuzonke kwababambiqhaza akuphenywanga ukuthola okungase kube yimithombo yale misoco edingeka kancane kanti ne-Body Mass Index (BMI) yabo ayiqoshwanga.
Hausa: Ba a binciki abincin yau da kullum na masu shiga don gano hanyoyin da za a iya samun ma'adanai guda uku ba, kuma ba a rubuta Fihirisar Adadin Nauyin Jikinsu, Body Mass Index (BMI) ba.
Northern Sotho: Dijo tša ka mehla tšeo bakgathatema ba di jago ga se tša nyakišišwa go hwetša methopo ye e kgonagalago ya dijonyana tše tharo, gomme le Dipalopalo ka ga Boima bja Mebele (BMI) ya bona ga se tša begwa.
Amharic: ለእነዚህ ሶስት ደቂቅ ንጥረ ምግቦች ምንጭ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉትን ምግቦች  ለማግኘት፤ የተሳታፊዎቹ  የየቀን አመጋገብ ዘይቤ ላይ ምርመራ አልተደረገም፣ የሰውነት ግዝፈት ጠቋሚ መረጃም (BMI) አልተመዘገበም፡፡

English: This is the first study of its kind measuring the effects of selenium, copper and zinc in pregnant women in Malawi.
Luganda: Kuno kwe kunoonyereza okusoose okupima ebiva ku seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki mu bakazi ab’embuto mu Malawi.
Yoruba: Èyí ni iṣẹ́ ìwádìí irú rẹ tí yóò wo ìwọn ìjẹyọ sẹ́líómù, kọ́pà àti síǹkì ní ara aláboyún ni Malawi.
Zulu: Lolu wucwaningo lokuqala lwalolu hlobo olukala imithelela yesileniyami, umthofi kanye nezinki kwabesifazane abakhulelwe eMalawi.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne nazari na farko da aka yi irinsa na auna tasirin sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadarin zin ga mata masu juna biyu a Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Tše ke dinyakišišo tša mathomo tša mohuta wa tšona tšeo di elago diabe tša seleniamo, tša koporo le tša zinki go basadi bao ba imilego ka Malawi.
Amharic: ይህ  በማላዊ በሚገኙ ነፍሰጡሮች ላይ  የሴሌኒየም፤ የመዳብ እና፤የዚንክ  ተጽእኖዎችን ለመለካት የተሰራ  በአይነቱ የመጀመሪያ የሆነ ጥናት ነው፡፡

English: Africa has some of the highest levels of preterm births - over 18% compared to Western countries at 5%, so researchers want to know if nutrition plays a role.
Luganda: Africa y’erimu ensi ezisinga okubaamu abakazi abazaala abaana abatannatuuka – ebitundu 18% n’okusingawo bw’ogeraageranya ensi z’Ebugwanjuba ku bitundu 5%, noolwekyo abanoonyereza baagala okumanya oba ng’endya erina ky’ekola ku kino.
Yoruba: Ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ ni ó ní ìkúlẹ̀ àìtójọ́ tó ga jùlọ ní ìwọn – léyìí tó ju 18% lọ tí a bá ṣe àfiwé rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ilú òyìnbó tọ́ ní 5% nítorí náà àwọn olùṣèwádìí fẹ́ mọ̀ bóyá ìjẹṣaralóore ní ipa tó ń kó.
Zulu: I-Afrika inesinye sezibalo eziphezulu zokuteta ngaphambi kwesinye- ngaphezu kuka-18% kuqhathaniswa no-5% wamazwe aseNtsonalanga, ngakho abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ezomsoco ziyanomthelela yini.
Hausa: Afirka tana da mafi girman matakan haihuwar bakwaini - sama da kashi 18% idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashen Yamma da kashi 5%, don haka masu bincike suna son sanin ko abinci mai gina jiki yana taka rawa.
Northern Sotho: Afrika e na le maemo a godimodimo a dipelego tša pele ga nako - go feta 18% ge e bapetšwa le dinaga tša ka Bodikela ka 5%, ka fao banyakišišo ba nyaka go tseba ge eba phepo e raloka tema go se.
Amharic: አፍሪካ በጣም ከፍተኛ ቅድመ ወሊድ ከሚከሰትባቸው ቦታዎች አንዷ ናት፡፡ 5%  ከሚከሰትባቸው ምእራባዊ ሃገሮች ጋር ስትወዳደር አፍሪካ 18% ላይ ናት፡፡ ስለዚህ ተመራማሪዎች  አመጋገብ ለዚህ ሚና ይጫወት እንደሆነ ማወቅ ይፈልጋሉ፡፡
